blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Agentic visual reasoning improves vision-language models by selectively enlarging evidence without adding new scene content, but the benefit depends on whether fine structure remains accessible and whether local observations stay grounded in the full scene. We identify three recurring bottlenecks: high-frequency detail can be attenuated during visual-token formation; spatially distributed evidence can remain encoded yet difficult for the language model to retrieve; and isolated crops can weaken whole-detail correspondence through scale and positional mismatch. ResVision addresses these limitations with two complementary components. Spectrum-Matched Resizing (SMR) estimates image complexity and selects an adaptive global sampling scale, avoiding unnecessary enlargement on simple inputs while allocating more visual tokens to detail-rich images. Context-Preserving Inspection (CPI) returns each inspected crop together with the complete working view, preserving local detail and global context across tool turns. We evaluate Direct and Agentic variants on four frontier VLMs and 29 benchmarks spanning six visual-reasoning families. Complete ResVision (Agentic Base plus SMR plus CPI) is best for every model, improving by 3.36 to 4.94 points over Direct Base and 1.87 to 2.94 points over Agentic Base. These results show that adaptive visual sampling and context-preserving inspection address distinct, complementary constraints in multimodal reasoning.
blocks.zh: 代理视觉推理通过有选择地扩展证据而不增加新的场景内容来改进视觉语言模型,但好处取决于精细的结构是否仍然可以使用,局部观测是否仍然扎根于整个场景. 我们发现三个反复出现的瓶颈:高频细节在视觉脚趾形成时可以减弱;空间分布的证据仍然可以编码,但语言模型难以检索;孤立的作物可以通过尺度和位置不匹配削弱整个细节的对应性。 《展望》用两个相辅相成的组成部分解决了这些局限性。 Spectrum-Matched Resization(SMR)估计图像复杂度,并选择一个适应性的全球采样尺度,避免在简单输入上不必要的扩展,同时将更多的视觉符号分配给细节丰富的图像. 上下文保存检查(CPI)将每个被检查的作物连同完整的工作视图一起返回,保存本地细节和整个工具转换的全球背景。 我们评估了四个边界甚高频和29个基准的直接和代理变体,涉及六个视理家庭。 完全反射(Agentic Base + SMR + CPI)对每个型号来说都是最好的,比直射基提高3.36至4.94分,比Agentic Base提高1.87至2.94分. 这些结果表明,适应性的视觉取样和上下文保护检查解决了多式联运推理中不同而互补的制约因素。

blocks.en: We introduce ResVision , a training-free framework that addresses these challenges through two complementary techniques. Spectrum-Matched Resizing (SMR) estimates each image’s fine-structure demand and selects the minimum global scale that places representative spatial frequencies within the visual-token passband under a bounded visual-token budget. Using the resulting working view, the VLM selects regions for closer inspection. Context-Preserving Inspection (CPI) returns each enlarged crop alongside the complete working view as separate, labeled image inputs. The crop provides local detail, while the complete view retains the spatial context and alternative evidence needed for interpretation. SMR adapts global sampling, the VLM selects where to inspect, and CPI maintains the full-image reference.

blocks.en: We evaluate these mechanisms through controlled diagnostics and downstream reasoning tasks. Mechanistic probes trace representations from patch projection to the positioned image blocks provided to the language model, revealing information attenuation, retrieval failure, and weakened whole–detail correspondence. Across four VLM families and 29 benchmarks, complete ResVision (Agentic Base+SMR+CPI) reaches a four-model mean Macro-29 of 75.93, improving by 3.88 points over Direct Base and 2.28 points over Agentic Base (VISTA). The gains hold for every model: 3.36–4.94 points over Direct Base and 1.87–2.94 points over Agentic Base. Focused component ablations on five diagnostic benchmarks further demonstrate the complementary contributions of SMR and CPI.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are threefold. (1) We identify three mechanisms underlying agentic visual reasoning: Intra-Token Bandwidth Limit , Contiguous-Token Retrieval Breakdown , and Whole–Detail Reference Gap , explaining both the benefits and failure modes of local inspection.
(2) We introduce SMR , which replaces fixed visual-token allocation with an image-adaptive rule that selects the minimum global scale needed to place representative spatial frequencies within the visual-token passband.
(3) We introduce CPI , which pairs each selected crop with the complete working view, preserving a full-image reference for locating, comparing, and interpreting local evidence throughout multi-turn reasoning.

blocks.en: 2 Diagnosing Visual-Token Bottlenecks
blocks.zh: 2 诊断可视-托肯瓶装

blocks.en: VLMs encode images into finite sequences of visual tokens before reasoning. We use Qwen 3.8-Flash-Next (Qwen 3.8) to trace visual evidence through tokenization and downstream reasoning, diagnosing three mechanisms along this path (Figure 2 ). Fine structure can be attenuated within individual tokens; evidence can remain encoded across neighboring tokens yet be difficult to retrieve; and an independently encoded crop can become harder to relate to the complete image. The first two mechanisms concern accessibility , explaining why changes in presentation can help without introducing new scene content. The third concerns correspondence , explaining why clearer local evidence can still yield a worse answer.

blocks.en: Evidence can remain encoded across neighboring visual tokens yet be difficult to assemble during reasoning. blocks.en: We move the same pattern from a token center toward its boundary while holding appearance and scale fixed. Figure 4 (a) plots the position-normalized response and mirrors the sweep about the boundary. At Stage 1, similarity to the token-centered pattern drops sharply as the pattern is divided across neighboring tokens. Stage-3 contextualization retains more of the cue, but the representation remains sensitive to grid alignment. The same structure is therefore represented differently when it lies within a token region and when it straddles a boundary. blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: The diagnosis motivates two design requirements: adapt visual sampling to image structure and preserve the scene reference for each local observation. ResVision implements these requirements in a training-free framework. Before inference, Spectrum-Matched Resizing (SMR) constructs a fixed, image-adaptive working view. The VLM reasons over this view and selects regions for closer inspection. Context-Preserving Inspection (CPI) returns each enlarged crop alongside the same complete working view. The components act at distinct points along the evidence path: SMR controls how scene structure is sampled before tokenization; agentic inspection concentrates evidence in selected regions; and CPI keeps each local observation jointly available with its source-scene landmarks.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We first evaluate two inference modes on a broad 29-benchmark suite. Direct mode compares Direct with Direct+ResVision, where ResVision contributes its SMR front end without tools. Agentic mode compares Agentic with Agentic+ResVision, where ResVision contributes the complete SMR+CPI system. Intermediate Agentic variants are retained as component ablations rather than main methods. We then use the original five-benchmark diagnostic slice for focused allocation, robustness, and latency analyses.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results on 29 Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 4.2 29项基准的主要结果

blocks.en: Table 1: Macro-29 accuracy under the four main conditions. Direct+ResVision enables SMR; Agentic+ResVision enables the complete SMR+CPI system. Each entry is the equal-weight mean over 29 benchmarks and three runs.
blocks.zh: 表1:四个主要条件下的宏-29准确度. Direct+Resvision使工管关系得以实现;Agentic+Resvision使完整的工管关系+CPI系统得以实现. 每个条目均等于29个基准和3个跑步。

blocks.en: Agentic+ResVision is best for every model. It reaches 76.90 on Qwen3.8, 79.02 on Kimi-K3, 71.97 on DeepSeek, and 75.83 on GLM (Table 1 ). Relative to Direct, the respective gains are 4.94, 3.36, 3.57, and 3.67 points; relative to Agentic, they are 2.94, 2.42, 1.87, and 1.88 points. Averaged equally across models, the complete system scores 75.93, compared with 72.05 for Direct and 73.65 for Agentic—gains of 3.88 and 2.28 points, respectively.
blocks.zh: Agentic+Resvision对每个模型都是最好的. 它在Qune3.8上达到76.90,在Kimi-K3上达到79.02,在DeepSeek上达到71.97,在GLM上达到75.83(表1). 相对于Direct,相应的收益分别为4.94,3.36,3.57和3.67分;相对于Agentic,分别是2.94,2.42,1.87和1.88分. 在各种模型中,整个系统平均得分是75.93分,而直接得分是72.05分,代理得分是73.65分,分别为3.88分和2.28分。

blocks.en: Both presentation and inspection contribute consistently. Direct+ResVision raises the four-model mean from 72.05 to 73.99, with per-model gains of 1.62–2.76 points, demonstrating that adaptive global presentation helps even without tool use. Agentic Base itself averages 73.65, 1.61 points above Direct, while complete ResVision adds another 2.28 points over Agentic Base. Thus neither a better initial presentation nor inspection alone explains the final result. The focused component analysis below separates the intermediate Agentic+SMR and CPI-only variants.
blocks.zh: 列报和检查都始终如一。 Direct+Resvision将四个模型的平均值从72.05提高到73.99,每个模型的得分为1.62-2.76分,表明适应性的全球表述即使没有工具使用也有帮助. 代理 基地本身平均为73.65分,比Direct高出1.61分,而完整的Resvision则比Agentic Base增加了2.28分. 因此,无论是更好的初步陈述还是检查都无法解释最终结果。 下面的重点成分分析将中间Agentic+SMR和只使用CPI的变体分开.

blocks.en: The two components remain complementary. Without SMR, CPI improves Agentic Base by 1.10–1.97 points (Table 2 ); Agentic+SMR and CPI-only average 75.10 and 75.07, respectively. Complete ResVision reaches 75.93 and exceeds the stronger single-component variant by 0.40–0.94 points in every model. This supports the intended interpretation of ResVision as Agentic Base+SMR+CPI rather than either component in isolation.
blocks.zh: 这两个组成部分仍然相辅相成。 如果没有工矿关系,消费物价指数将代理基数分别提高1.10-1.97分(表2);Agentic+工矿关系指数和仅消费物价指数平均值分别为75.10和75.07。 完全反射达到75.93分,超过每个模型中较强的单元变体0.40-0.94分. 这支持了对Resvision作为Agentic Base+SMR+CPI的意向解释,而不是孤立地两个部分.

blocks.en: Table 2: CPI-only component ablation. Macro-29; complete ResVision enables SMR+CPI.
blocks.zh: 表2: 仅限消费物价指数成分消耗。 Macro-29; 完整的Resvision可以实现SMR+CPI.

blocks.en: The gains are broad but not uniform across tasks. Complete ResVision is the unique best main condition on 21 of 29 benchmarks for Qwen3.8, 16 for Kimi-K3, and 15 each for DeepSeek and GLM. Relative to Agentic Base, its largest family-level gains occur in Math & Logic (4.59–8.34 points across models) and Hallucination & Count (2.08–6.19 points). Medical & World changes by 0.42–2.19 points, while General Visual is comparatively flat ( − 0.30 -0.30 to + 1.07 +1.07 ). Macro-29 therefore provides a conservative test: it includes many tasks with weak sensitivity to visual-token allocation, yet the aggregate gain remains positive for every model.
blocks.zh: 成果是广泛的,但各项任务并不一致。 全面反省是Qune3.8,基米-K3的29个基准中的21个,以及DeepSeek和GLM各15个基准中独一无二的最佳主要条件. 相对于Agentic Base,其最大的家族层面收益出现在Math & Logic (4.59–8.34分跨模型)和Hallucination & Count (2.08–6.19分). 医学 & World 变化0.42–2.19分,而通用视觉相对平坦(−0.30–0.30至+1.07+1.07). Macro-29因此提供了一个保守的测试:它包含了许多对视觉脚趾分配敏感度低的任务,然而每个模型的总收益仍然为正数.

blocks.zh: 4.4 重点组成部分分析

blocks.en: The following controlled analyses retain the original five-benchmark slice—BabyVision, VLMsAreBiased, BLINK, VStarBench [ Wu and Xie(2024) ] , and MMVP [ Tong et al.(2024)Tong, Liu, Zhai, Ma, LeCun, and Xie ] —because it provides dense three-run measurements for all ablations and exposes the visual bottlenecks studied in Sec. 2 . Macro-5 is the equal-weight mean across these five benchmarks.

blocks.en: Table 5 isolates SMR and CPI on Kimi-K3 and Qwen3.8. SMR alone improves Direct by 5.26 and 8.88 points, respectively. Within agentic inference, CPI adds 4.15 and 5.39 points without SMR, and a further 2.21 and 1.85 points when SMR is enabled. The complete system exceeds Direct+SMR by 4.46 and 5.66 points, showing that adaptive presentation and context-preserving local inspection contribute at different stages.

blocks.en: 4.5 Adaptive versus Fixed Visual-Token Allocation
blocks.zh: 4.5 适应性与固定视觉设备分配

blocks.en: We replace SMR with fixed targets of 1,024–5,120 visual tokens while retaining CPI and all other settings. Accuracy is non-monotonic in the fixed budget: the strongest fixed target is 2,048 tokens for both tested models, while adaptive SMR improves on it by 3.31 points on Kimi-K3 and 3.36 points on Qwen3.8 (Table 6 ). This supports allocating sampling density from image structure rather than using a uniform token target.
blocks.zh: 我们在保留消费物价指数和所有其他设置的同时,用1 024-5 120个视觉标志的固定目标取代工管关系。 准确性在固定预算中是非莫名的:最强的固定目标是两个测试模型的2,048个令牌,而适应性的工管关系则在基米-K3上提高了3.31分,在Qune3.8上提高了3.36分(表6). 这支持从图像结构中分配采样密度,而不是使用统一的符号目标.

NaViT packs variable-resolution inputs, Pix2Struct preserves aspect ratio under a token budget, and FlexiViT supports multiple patch sizes [ Dehghani et al.(2023)Dehghani, Mustafa, Djolonga, Heek, Minderer,
Caron, Steiner, Puigcerver, Geirhos, Alabdulmohsin, Oliver, Padlewski,
Gritsenko, Lucic, and Houlsby , Lee et al.(2023)Lee, Joshi, Turc, Hu, Liu, Eisenschlos, Khandelwal,

Angelova , Rao et al.(2021)Rao, Zhao, Liu, Lu, Zhou, and
Hsieh , Bolya et al.(2023)Bolya, Fu, Dai, Zhang, Feichtenhofer, and
Hoffman ] . High-resolution VLMs divide native images into tiles or combine low- and high-resolution branches to expose dense detail [ Li et al.(2024)Li, Yang, Liu, Ma, Zhang, Yang, Sun, Liu, and
Bai , Xu et al.(2024)Xu, Yao, Guo, Cui, Ni, Ge, Chua, Liu, Sun, and
Huang , Hong et al.(2024)Hong, Wang, Lv, Xu, Yu, Ji, Wang, Wang, Dong, Ding,
and Tang ] . These designs demonstrate that visual-token allocation strongly affects what a model can recover. However, they usually determine allocation from image geometry, a fixed resolution policy, or importance estimated after tokenization. The same pixel dimensions can contain very different amounts of fine structure, so geometry alone need not predict the sampling required by a particular image. ResVision addresses this complementary question before reasoning begins: SMR measures image structure and selects a budgeted working scale that matches it to the encoder’s usable frequency range, without retraining or modifying the visual backbone.

blocks.en: 5.2 Agentic Visual Reasoning
blocks.zh: 5.2 视觉原因

blocks.en:
Agentic visual reasoning extends active perception by allowing a model to gather evidence as its reasoning evolves [ Bajcsy(1988) , Mnih et al.(2014)Mnih, Heess, Graves, and
Kavukcuoglu , Yao et al.(2023)Yao, Zhao, Yu, Du, Shafran, Narasimhan, and
Cao ] . Program- and tool-based systems compose specialist modules [ Gupta and Kembhavi(2023) , Surís et al.(2023)Surís, Menon, and
Vondrick , Yang et al.(2023)Yang, Li, Wang, Lin, Azarnasab, Ahmed, Liu, Liu,
Zeng, and Wang , Wu et al.(2023)Wu, Yin, Qi, Wang, Tang, and Duan , Liu et al.(2024)Liu, Cheng, Liu, Zhang, Li, Ren, Zou, Yang, Su, Zhu,
Zhang, Gao, and Li ] , while V* and VISTA let a general-purpose VLM actively search or retrieve visual observations [ Wu and Xie(2024) , Han et al.(2026)Han, Hu, Qiu, Wu, and He ] . Related methods ground language in selected regions, introduce visual prompts, or use drawings and interleaved visual states to support reasoning [ Cai et al.(2024)Cai, Liu, Mustikovela, Meyer, Chai, Park, and
Lee , Peng et al.(2024)Peng, Wang, Dong, Hao, Huang, Ma, Ye, and
Wei , You et al.(2024)You, Zhang, Gan, Du, Zhang, Wang, Cao, Chang, and
Yang , Shao et al.(2024)Shao, Qian, Xiao, Song, Zong, Wang, Liu, and
Li , Gao et al.(2025)Gao, Li, Cao, and Li , Hu et al.(2024)Hu, Shi, Fu, Roth, Ostendorf, Zettlemoyer, Smith, and
Krishna ] . Web and desktop agents further show that perception and grounding remain limiting factors when visual observations drive actions [ Zheng et al.(2024)Zheng, Gou, Kil, Sun, and Su , Koh et al.(2024)Koh, Lo, Jang, Duvvur, Lim, Huang, Neubig, Zhou,
Salakhutdinov, and Fried , Xie et al.(2024)Xie, Zhang, Chen, Li, Zhao, Cao, Hua, Cheng, Shin,
Lei, Liu, Xu, Zhou, Savarese, Xiong, Zhong, and Yu ] , a capability directly examined by VisualToolBench [ Guo et al.(2025)Guo, Tyagi, Gosai, Vergara, Park,
Hernández Montoya, Zhang, Hu, He, Liu, and
Srinivasa ] . Most of this literature focuses on choosing an action, invoking the right tool, or obtaining a sharper local observation. It gives less attention to how the returned observation should remain connected to the scene from which it was extracted. Visual Funnel is closely related in combining focal evidence with multiscale context [ Jung et al.(2026)Jung, Go, Jeon, Yoon, and Kim ] , but relies on attention-guided views rather than maintaining a stable complete reference across an agentic trajectory. blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We identify three mechanisms that explain how local inspection can improve or impair visual reasoning by altering evidence accessibility and scene correspondence without introducing new scene content. ResVision translates these insights into a training-free framework: SMR improves visual accessibility by adapting the working scale to image structure, while CPI preserves whole–detail correspondence throughout local inspection. Across four VLM families and 29 benchmarks, complete ResVision (Agentic Base+SMR+CPI) is the strongest main configuration for every model, reaching a four-model mean Macro-29 of 75.93—3.88 points above Direct Base and 2.28 points above Agentic Base. The gains are largest on reasoning families that depend strongly on fine structure and distributed evidence, while flatter families expose the expected limits of additional visual sampling. Focused ablations nevertheless show that SMR and CPI each contribute and that their combination is consistently strongest. These findings highlight accessibility and correspondence as two fundamental requirements for agentic visual reasoning, paving the way for visual agents that can perceive fine details and interpret them within the broader scene.
blocks.zh: 我们确定了三种机制,解释地方检查如何通过改变证据的可获取性和现场通信而不引入新的场景内容来改进或损害视觉推理。 展望将这些见解转化为无培训框架: SMR通过调整工作尺度以适应图像结构来改善视觉无障碍,而CPI则保留了整个–详细对应的全局检查. 在四个VLM家族和29个基准中,完整的Resvision(Agentic Base+SMR+CPI)是每个模型最强的主要配置,达到四个型号的Macro-29,即直接基地75.93-3.88分,代理基地2.28分. 收益最大的是严重依赖精细结构和分布式证据的推理家庭,而奉承家庭则暴露了额外视觉抽样的预期限度. 不过,重点突出的描述表明,工管关系和消费物价指数都作出了贡献,两者的结合始终是最强的。 这些结论强调无障碍和通信是代理视觉推理的两个基本要求,为视觉代理铺平了道路,这些代理能够感知到细微的细节并在更广泛的场景中加以解释.

blocks.en: The Direct comparison isolates SMR before any tool use: Direct processes the original image, whereas Direct+SMR processes the spectrum-matched working view. The agentic comparison forms a complete 2 × 2 2\times 2 design. Removing SMR retains CPI with the original image presentation; removing CPI keeps SMR but restores VISTA-style isolated-crop replies; removing both exactly recovers VISTA. At each position, we compare the best-matching Stage-1 patch projection and Stage-3 final visual token with their respective centered-pattern references. The main-paper plot reflects this center-to-boundary sweep about the boundary, producing a position-normalized profile that removes absolute-position and reference-token effects while preserving the measured dependence on boundary distance. The released JSON retains the original unreflected measurements. This readout tests how token-grid alignment changes the representation without changing the pattern’s appearance or scale.
blocks.zh: 边界探测器将14×1414的14次图案从一个合并地块的中心向中间边界移动。 在每一个位置,我们比较最佳匹配的阶段-1补丁投影和阶段-3最终的视觉符号与各自的中心模式参考. 主纸图反映了这种对边界的中线对边界的扫射,产生了一个位置常态化的剖面图,在保留测量到的对边界距离的依赖性的同时,去除绝对位置和参考键效应. 释放的JSON保留了原始未反射的测量. 此读出测试符格- 网格对齐如何在不改变图案外观或比例的情况下改变表达式 。

blocks.en: The counting probe uses a 320 × 64 320\times 64 strip with M = 10 M=10 horizontal token positions and evaluates K ∈ { 6 , 8 , 10 , 12 , 15 , 18 , 20 } K\in\{6,8,10,12,15,18,20\} . For each value of K K , we generate 60 independently arranged strips. We freeze the complete VLM and extract the Stage-3 token grid for every strip. The diagnostic feature is the spatially ordered concatenation x = concat ⁡ ( z 1 , … , z N ) , x=\operatorname{concat}(z_{1},\ldots,z_{N}), (16) where z i z_{i} is a final visual token and N N is the number of tokens in the complete grid. A ridge-linear classifier W ​ x + b Wx+b with coefficient 0.1 0.1 is trained on 45 strips per count and evaluated on the remaining 15 while the VLM remains frozen. Its held-out accuracy measures whether exact count is linearly decodable from the frozen representation.

For the generation comparison, the same evaluation images are paired with a direct integer-count prompt. We report greedy exact-match accuracy and the normalized probability assigned to the correct one- or two-digit integer. The contrast therefore holds the visual input and frozen VLM fixed while comparing a supervised linear readout with the model’s native generative readout.

blocks.en: E.6 Whole–Detail Representation Diagnostic
blocks.zh: E.6 整体-详细代表性诊断

blocks.en: We complement the main-paper grounding experiment with a representation-level control on the same 50 BabyVision images. For each crop width, we match the same source patch between the complete image and the crop. The Stage-1 patch projection tests whether the local visual content itself changes; the Stage-3 final visual token measures drift after contextual visual processing; and the Stage-4 token additionally includes the crop-local positional frame. At 12.5% crop width, Stage-3 similarity falls to 0.389 and Stage-4 similarity to 0.305, while the Stage-1 projection remains unchanged. The dashed line marks the mean similarity between unrelated foreground tokens.
blocks.zh: 我们补充了主纸地面试验,对同样的50个婴儿视觉图像进行了表现级别控制。 对于每个裁剪宽度,我们在完整图像和裁剪之间匹配相同的源补丁. Stage-1补丁投影测试局部视觉内容本身是否改变;Stage-3最终视觉符号测量背景视觉处理后的漂移;Stage-4标志还包含作物-局部位置框架. 在作物宽度为12.5%时,第3阶段的相似性降至0.389,第4阶段的相似性降至0.305,而第1阶段的预测则保持不变。 虚线标志了无关联前缘符号之间的平均相似性.

blocks.en: Two complementary diagnostics show how retrieval and grounding failures unfold. During dense counting, the peak attended visual-token coordinate reaches the right edge before all objects have been enumerated. During crop grounding, resetting the crop origin produces localization error that grows with the target’s displacement from the source-image origin.

blocks.en: Across the probes, high-frequency reconstruction weakens through the full encoder, phase distinctions contract, and the response to a local feature grows with its presented size. These measurements support the accessibility account in Sec. 2 : presentation scale changes which distinctions reach a useful representation. SMR operationalizes this observation by assigning scale from measured fine structure, while CPI addresses the complementary problem of preserving what enlarged evidence means in the complete scene. Appendix F gives the exact resizing protocol used by the reported experiments.

blocks.en: SMR follows the active-tile spectrum and minimum-cost frequency-matching rule in Sec. 3.1 . The image is converted to grayscale, partitioned into p × p p\times p tiles, and ranked by gradient energy. For multiple images under a shared cap, the adapter reserves the per-image minimum and proportionally reduces requested allocations above that minimum when necessary. Grid alignment remains within the resulting allocations. Scale choices are computed once per image and cached throughout the interaction.

blocks.en: G System-Level Error Taxonomy
blocks.zh: G 系统级错误分类

blocks.en: The analysis covers the complete five-benchmark, three-run archive for VISTA and ResVision. Its unit is one judged prediction for one model, run, and question, giving 4 × 3 × 1,679 = 20,148 4\times 3\times 1{,}679=20{,}148 predictions per method. A Kimi-K3 judge assigns every incorrect prediction to one mutually exclusive category using the task prompt, reference answer, final response, and inspection trace. Percentages use all 20,148 predictions as the denominator.
blocks.zh: 分析涵盖了完整的五标,三跑的VISTA和ResVision档案. 它的单位是对一个模型的一个判断预测,运行,和疑问,给出4×3×1,679=20,148 4\times 3\times 1{,}679=20{,}148 预测每个方法. 一名Kimi-K3法官利用任务即时、参考答复、最后答复和检查跟踪,将每一个不正确的预测分配给一个相互排斥的类别。 百分比将所有20 148项预测作为分母。

blocks.en: Detail accessibility and detail interpretation are distinct: a cue may be difficult to distinguish at the full-image scale, or it may be visible but used incorrectly. We partition every incorrect prediction into six mutually exclusive classes.
blocks.zh: 详细可及性和细节解释是不同的:一个提示可能难以在全图像尺度上区分,或者可能可见但使用不正确. 我们把每一个不正确的预测分成六个相互排斥的类别。

blocks.en: F1—referent binding is an identity error: the model reads a local cue but attaches it to the wrong object, cell, image, or coordinate. In the D6 counting case (Appendix H.1 ), the crop makes the vertical marks legible but removes the row and column headers. The defining question is which entity or location does this evidence belong to?
blocks.zh: F1 — referent 绑定是一个身份错误: 模型读取一个本地提示, 但把它附加在错误的对象, 单元格, 图像, 或坐标上 。 在D6计数例(附录H.1 )中,作物使垂直标记可以识别,但去掉行和列头. 决定性的问题是,这些证据属于哪个实体或地点?

blocks.en: F2—candidate-contrast omission is a comparison error: the model accepts one plausible candidate without checking alternatives that could distinguish it. In the horse reconstruction case (Appendix H.4 ), the extra yellow bar in A becomes decisive only when the candidate inventories are compared. The defining question is what distinguishes this candidate from the others?
blocks.zh: F2-candidate-contrast 省略是一个比较错误:模型接受一个可信的候选人而不检查能够区分它的替代品. 在马重建案(Appendix H.4 )中,A中的额外黄条只有在比较候选目录时才变得具有决定性. 决定性的问题是,该候选人与其他候选人有何区别?

blocks.en: F3—spatial/transform inconsistency is a relational error: the model recognizes relevant local parts but combines them under an incorrect direction, rotation, topology, ordering, or cross-view correspondence. In the rotation case (Appendix H.2 ), wedge colors can be read correctly while the requested transformation and answer option become mismatched. The defining question is how must these parts correspond after the stated relation or transformation?
blocks.zh: F3-空间/转换不一致是一个关系错误:模型识别相关的局部部分,但在不正确的方向,旋转,地形,订购,或交叉视图通信下将其合并. 在旋转例(Appendix H.2 )中,楔形颜色可以正确读取,而请求的转换和答案选项则会变得不匹配. 决定性的问题是,在所述的关系或转变之后,这些部分必须如何对应?

blocks.en: F4—local-detail overinterpretation is an interpretation error: the model identifies the correct entity and region but gives a local attribute the wrong meaning because the crop omits scale, pose, or object-level context. In the volleyball case (Appendix H.5 ), the arm-and-ball crop supports a plausible “set” interpretation, while the full pose supports “bump.” The defining question is what does this cue mean in the complete object or scene?
blocks.zh: F4——局部-细节过度解释是一个解释错误:模型识别出正确的实体和区域,但给出了一个局部属性错误的含义,因为裁剪省略了尺度,姿势,或对象级上下文. 在排球案(附录H.5)中,臂球作物支持一种合理的“套式”解释,而全姿则支持“弹”字。 决定性的问题是,这个提示在完整的物体或场景中意味着什么?

blocks.en: F5—coverage/count aggregation collects failures to exhaustively enumerate repeated instances or reconcile partial counts. Its defining question is has the reasoning covered and reconciled every relevant instance?
blocks.zh: F5 -- -- 涵盖/汇总收集了未能详尽列举重复事例或核对部分计数的情况。 它的决定性问题是,推理是否涵盖并调和了每一个相关案例?

blocks.en: F6—other errors contains residual failures outside the preceding five classes.
blocks.zh: F6-其他错误包含前五类之外的剩余故障.

blocks.en: Together, F1–F6 separate identity, comparison, relation, interpretation, aggregation, and other residual causes. CPI supplies grounding for the first four, while the complete interaction can also support systematic coverage and reconciliation.
blocks.zh: F1-F6 两者加在一起,分别存在,比较,关系,解释,汇总,以及其他残余原因. 消费物价指数为前四阶段提供基础,而完整的互动也可以支持系统覆盖与和解。

blocks.en: The question asks which option contains exactly the same pieces as the target horse. Options A and C look similar, so the decision depends on comparing their complete piece inventories rather than describing the target alone.

blocks.en: • Direct answers A, A, and C. It notices the overall resemblance, but only one run distinguishes the candidates correctly. • VISTA answers A in all three runs. Its close view gives a detailed description of the target horse, yet does not place A and C in the same comparison; the extra yellow bar in A is therefore overlooked. • ResVision answers C in all three runs. It compares the target, A, and C together, checks the piece inventory item by item, and rejects A after finding its extra yellow bar. Why this matters. Inspection should test competing hypotheses against one shared reference and compare every plausible option.

blocks.en: H.5 Case E (F4): Interpret the Detail in the Whole Pose
blocks.zh: H.5 案例E(F4):解释整个Pose的细节

blocks.en: The question asks whether the player is more likely to bump or set the volleyball. A close view of the arms and ball can suggest either action; the whole-body pose is needed to decide which interpretation is physically consistent.
blocks.zh: 质疑球员是否更可能撞倒或设置排球. 对武器和球的仔细观察可以说明两种行动;需要全身姿势来决定哪种解释在物理上是一致的。

blocks.en: • Direct answers A (bump) in all three runs. In this example the full image already preserves the decisive cue: the player is leaning forward with joined forearms held low. • VISTA answers B (set) in all three runs. The crop emphasizes a bent arm and a high ball, which supports a plausible local story about setting, but hides the rest of the posture that contradicts it. • ResVision answers A (bump) in all three runs. It inspects the arm-and-ball region while retaining the full pose, then checks that the local cue agrees with the joined forearm platform and forward body geometry. Why this matters. This example separates detail accessibility from interpretation: Direct already reads the complete pose correctly, but the local inspection supports a misleading action hypothesis.
